notes.title: Dungeon Munchies launches out of Early Access on July 28!
notes.content:
Hi, all! I'm Scofa and it's been a while, hasn't it.

Good news: We're still alive.

[h3]Better News: Dungeon Munchies will officially be released on July 28![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/597be9be1efac1372750ea6601eaea6fa26bcd1d.jpg[/img]

For new people, Dungeon Munchies is a side-scrolling platformer where you hunt, cook, and eat monsters to gain their powers! You are a hungry, hungry zombie finding your way (and yourself) as you traverse through a vast underground city.

Fill up and suit up to secure your place at the top of the food chain!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/dc481e50c4bcedfadc01bb01c5735a169db2c57f.gif[/img]

Got the munchies? Throw those bits and pieces together and make yourself a feast!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/6e8faaadf8167ee7504cca64d2ba9327a9c1ce00.gif[/img]


[h2]How will the official release differ from the Early Access versions?[/h2]

Once Dungeon Munchies leaves Early Access, it will have all the content in the Early Access plus:

[h3]New enemies![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/a116fce40f7189f44e3e530f67153feaaa05314d.gif[/img]


[h3]The greatest weapons ever made![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/dbc819a000a98cd0c7d53a085ef371c9cf0fd2af.gif[/img]


[h3]Cooking with friends! (They'll make you do all the work) [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/2b3f25aabdf756a179cfb462104cb2ddda5e6bca.gif[/img]

[h3]New Languages![/h3]
Japanese, Korean, Spanish, and German!

[h3]The End...[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/99d67d8c6667d3932bed11bc7f6976b04764e54b.jpg[/img]
Continuing from where we left off in Chapter Two, this last update will reveal the final fate of you and your friends!

[h3]Price[/h3]
Another important difference will be PRICE! Once it releases on July 28, we will raise the game's price to reflect its completed state. If you were on the wall about Dungeon Munchies, grab it now to secure that delicious early access price!

==========================

I want to say "thank you" to everyone once more.
During development, we experienced excitement, pain, fatigue, and joy.
Without your feedback, reviews, memes, art, and support, we wouldn't be here.
Thank you to all who have helped us complete this wild game.
I hope you'll all enjoy the official release of Dungeon Munchies.
See you on July 28!

- Scofa

notes.title: A Series of Mini-Updates
notes.content:
[Open Beta] 0.3.1.26
1. Fixed game startup issue for some machines.
2. Fixed issue involving errors when enemies are killed.

[Open Beta] 0.3.1.29

1. Fixed Toxic Tempest not being triggered by Bat Soup, Fried Leg Tenders, etc.
2. English error text is now displayed when dialogue is missing.
3. Fixed Tentacle-Stir fry activating without a weapon.
4. Various other bug fixes.

[Open Beta] 0.3.1.43

In this update, we greatly optimized the game's code. Players previously stuck at the main menu should try opening the game again to see if it still occurs.

1. Re-organized images, reduced portrait image sizes.
2. Removed outdated, unused assets.
3. Changed asset loading times. Assets are now loaded when used, not loaded all at once.
4. Fixed lag caused by Portable Turret
5. Fixed a bug where certain sounds could not be controlled by the game's volume sliders.
6. Fixed players getting stuck on a wall and dying during Grill's escort mission.

We made some pretty fundamental changes, so please report any errors and graphical glitches you encounter. We'll try to fix them as soon as possible.

[Open Beta] 0.3.1.44
1. Fixed double jump at game start bug.
2. Fixed a bug that blocked skipping already-read dialogue.
3. Fixed a bug that caused the Blood Lotus description to disappear.

[Open Beta] 0.3.1.45
1. Fixed graphical errors in a few levels
2. Clam Tonic blasts now activate during spear attacks and Spear Flurry.
3. Improved Bat Soup infection speed.
4. Raised base maximum mana and mana recovery rate for staves.
5. Reduced Ice Shield exhaust rate
6. Added visual effects to the Flaming Halberd and Toxic Tempest.
7. Fixed Toxic Tempest graphical glitches when inflicting damage.
8. Fixed Bow & Arrow angle inaccuracy issue.
9. Fixed a bug where the Sweaty Sports Drink did not have any effect.
10. White icons will no longer appear when opening the Chpt. 3 weapons menu.
11. Fixed bullet hit effect disappearing after moving to another room.

[Open Beta] 0.3.1.46
1. Chpt. 3 recipe menu closed.

[Open Beta] 0.3.1.47
1. Fixed Power Bank charging bugs.
2. Toxic Tempest should now work with：
    1. Main Damage：Fried Soft-Shelled Scythe, Cursed Popsicle, Blood Lotus Tea, and other hit-related effects.
    2. Magic Damage：Fried Soft-Shelled Scythe, Fried Spider Cutlet & Dried Insight Shrooms

[Open Beta]0.3.1.48
1. Null Errors fixed. 
2. Fixed a graphical glitch when clicking on an empty stomach cell.

[Open Beta] 0.3.1.49
1. Fix graphical glitches in Putrid battle.

notes.content:
[h1]Ver. 0.2.7.1 Patch Notes[/h1]
[h3]Adjusting Difficulty[/h3]

This patch is mostly adjustments to the game's difficulty based on player feedback we received. Thanks everyone!

1. Reduced knockback. Players shouldn't be knocked off platforms with one drone hit.
2. Adjusted platforms in Steeped City. It should be a friendlier work environment now.
3. Adjusted platforms for Steeped City Boss Final Phase. Friendlier boss fight.
4. Lowered freeze time from ice spikes.
5. Reduced trap/hazard speed in Snow Peak.
6. Fixed apple monster's snowball not disappearing.
7. Reduced damage from Core(Boss) projectiles.
8. Smoothed out difficulty curve for Steeped City & Snow Peak
9. Reduced laser & ice spike damage
10. Removed "This key has been used." message from remapping controls.


0.2.7.4
=====

1. Our minions will not block enemies' bullets now.
2. Optimize performance in snow maps.

notes.title: Dungeon Munchies: Chapter Two to be released on December 4!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/be3e69a8f0e565fcb9b3fb568625da51640d755c.png[/img]

[h1]Dungeon Munchies: Chapter Two to be released on December ![/h1]
[h3]Bringing you more than double the gameplay and story content![/h3]

[h2]Explore New Biomes[/h2]
The plant army's not-so-secret barracks, an entire sunken city and an AI-controlled high-tech facility... These new areas will challenge your ability to jump, climb, swim and fly!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/57fcfaced732f0ceebff5d8ef342dd7333dc5935.gif[/img]

[h2]Encounter new [strike]Enemies[/strike] Ingredients[/h2]
Watch out for giant leeches, robots and more sentient vegetables! Get ready to butcher new creatures and collect their guts! Anything can be cooked into delicious food, you just have to believe!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/4bc808170a80b7079132bcfbc7071fb409c6b74c.gif[/img]

[h2]A Whole New Recipe Book[/h2]
There's a whole new menu to cook up in this update, as well as a new upgrade system. Dishes not good enough for you? Then improve your technique with your insight points!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/14ad36ad0357551c139b2aad9d59f1bcab8573e7.gif[/img]

[h2]Weapons 'R Us[/h2]
The kitchen's stocked and so's the armory! We got grappling hooks, new gun-swords, and plain ol' magic staves, all sold from a convenient new vending machine!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/c352a924004f806f36bf03b643b7c49012973ea0.gif[/img]

[h2]Wack Boss Fights[/h2]
More bosses and badder bosses than released in chapter 1. You best be prepared to defeat this mean fruit salad.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/1cfca438d1ba4a84be5d4a6e9212bdce7cd2fd67.gif[/img]


[h2]There's Also A Story Apparently[/h2]
Chapter 2 picks up right where we left off, revealing more about the dungeon and its denizens as you explore and mingle. Zombies don't need to worry about social distancing, so go out there and make new friends... and enemies! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34337227/1d737aaf444588ceb2dee2320c89c5ec1e333eff.gif[/img]

Thank you for waiting patiently.
Expect us on December, 2020!

With the new content, we will be adjusting the price of Dungeon Munchies to $14.99 (US). Please use the time to take advantage of the current prices. Tell your friends before they miss out!

Hope to see you all cookin' the dungeon soon!

notes.title: Monthly Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hi, I'm Scofa and here are some updates to Dungeon Munchies. Thank you for your patience and sorry for the delay.

Due to dumb personal issues, Scofa made the terrible crime of not submitting a devlog last month. Since he committed an unforgivable transgression, we have permanently removed Scofa from [strike]existence[/strike] the team. He's been replaced by a new Scofa who will properly take on that responsibility.

[u][b]Incoming Features[/b][/u]
These are features we hope to implement within the next month or two.

[u]Custom Controls[/u]
- Set your own controls.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34337227/6e32fcc69b891d08a6f35b678073f2ade683a9c3.png[/img]

[u]Save Slots [/u]
- Multiple saves enabled.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34337227/3148aebf041df48923ec00a0038b9dad2648abcf.png[/img]

[u]Difficulty Settings[/u]
- So you can choose to play through the story relatively easily, or challenge harder enemies.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34337227/fb6c041f33099b61d2b35cf1670c311a1b55663f.png[/img]

- On harder difficulties, bosses have new attack patterns.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34337227/8566f3153ee5d0108a29c003f15611a29badeba8.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34337227/1eb7ff0672e9b4e04b2989e6e334320e8ee4937f.gif[/img]

[u][b]The Next Chapter...[/b][/u]
We'd like the story content to be a secret until the game is released, but here's a preview of one of the new maps: The Tundra (temp. name)
Defining Characteristic: Cold, very cold.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34337227/908cc6088eb73ef0e50b6476e56be320a38fba43.png[/img]
There is also an angry tomato somewhere in there [strike]to enforce regular monthly devlogs[/strike].
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34337227/f55cf3b0baf1f8cb78976aab1b735bb3141e2d6a.png[/img]

Sorry about being silent over the past two months. We've been working hard to bring features and new content to Dungeon Munchies. In the future we'll do a better job communicating those changes to everyone.

Thank you for sticking with Dungeon Munchies!
